sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
4.5.8

Mobile improvements across club customization and My Account, plus club workflow and embed fixes. Sites running 4.5.6 also pick up 4.5.7, which was never published separately.

  • Adding wines on a phone. The shipment customize screen now opens a full-screen browse sheet with search and the same club pricing, instead of a cramped type-ahead box. Desktop is unchanged.
  • Customize on small screens. Item rows stack rather than squeeze, and the sticky action button can be offset per site so it no longer collides with a theme's own fixed header or bar.
  • My Account on mobile. Clearer profile layout, a denser tab strip, and an indicator dot marking an upcoming shipment that needs attention.
  • Club workflow. Members are prompted to re-authenticate in place rather than being dropped, saved customizations now confirm with a toast, and shipment manifest and styling controls were added.
  • Embed. Studio sessions recover instead of dead-ending, the shopper's own address is forwarded correctly for fraud checks, and a double page-load on single-page sites was fixed.

No customer data, cart contents or orders are affected by this update.
